answer.reason: The supplied draft answer identifies option A, 178,332 covered jobs, as the correct figure for Tennessee private-sector employment in NAICS 54 for December 2024.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Tennessee, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 178,332 covered jobs
B. 163,166 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Tennessee statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/47000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
